title: Past Perfect / Pluscuamperfecto (past of the past)
bridge: N'ụdị a na-akọwa na pluscuamperfecto (emeela) na-emepụta akụkọ ndoro ndoro gara aga n'ime ọtụtụ gara aga. N'igbo, past perfect (emeela) na-eme ihe ndoro ndoro n'ime ọtụtụ gara aga, mana ọ bụrụ na ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a. N'igbo, o si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'had' + 'participio', ma ọ bụrụ na ụdị a na-akpọ 'had' na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'had' na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a. N'igbo, o si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'had' na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a. N'igbo, o si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'had' na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a.
rule: Past perfect na-akpọ na 'had' (n'ime ndoro ndoro ndoro) + participio gara aga. O si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'had' + participio. N'ime ndoro ndoro ndoro, o si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'had' + participio. N'ime ndoro ndoro ndoro, o si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'had not' (hadn't) + participio. N'ime ndoro ndoro ndoro, o si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'Had' + ndoro + participio. O si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after'. Nkọwa: 'I had finished my homework before dinner' (emeela m tụkwasịrị m nkwụ ụbọchị gara aga). O si na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'after' na 'before' ọ bụrụ na ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'past simple' ma ọ bụrụ na ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'past perfect' na-eme ka ndoro ndoro n'ime ụdị a na-akpọ 'past perfect'.

rule: Ndoro 1 (Type 1) bụrụ naanị maka ndoro ndoro na ndoro na ndoro. O na-emeghe na: If + subject + verb na present simple, + subject + will + verb base. Example: If it rains, we will stay at home. title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Nzọụlite: Mpụmụ na Ato
bridge: N'igbo, nzọụlite na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'nzọụlite' na-akwado na nke ndị a na-akpọ 'to be' + nke a na-akpọ 'past participle'. N'ihi na n'igbo, ndị na-eme nzọụlite na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'by' na-akpọ 'na' ma ọ bụ 'site na'. Ma n'igbo, ndị na-eme nzọụlite na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'se' na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'reflexive' (nke a na-akpọ 'se'). N'ihi na n'igbo, ndị na-eme nzọụlite na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'se' na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'reflexive'. N'ihi na n'igbo, ndị na-eme nzọụlite na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'se' na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'reflexive'.
rule: Nzọụlite na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'to be' na-arịọnụ n'ụzọ dị iche (nke a na-akpọ 'present simple': am/is/are; nke a na-akpọ 'past simple': was/were) + nke a na-akpọ 'past participle' nke otu nke ndị a. Otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'subject' nke otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'active' na-akwado na nke a na-akpọ 'complement agent' na-akpọ 'by' (ma ọ bụ na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'by' na-akpọ 'na' ma ọ bụ 'site na' nwere ike ịgbanwe ma ọ bụ ịdịghị iche). Iji mepụta nzọụlite, otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'object' nke otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'active' na-akwado na nke a na-akpọ 'subject'. Ejemplos: Active: 'The chef cooks the meal' → Passive: 'The meal is cooked by the chef'. N'ụzọ dị iche, anyị na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'is/are' na-arịọnụ n'ụzọ dị iche (singular/plural). N'ụzọ dị iche, anyị na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'was/were'. Nke a na-akpọ 'past participle' bụ nke a na-akpọ 'third form' nke otu nke ndị a (nke a na-akpọ 'regular': -ed; nke a na-akpọ 'irregular': ụkpụrụ). N'ihi na nke a na-akpọ 'exceptions': nke a na-akpọ 'intransitive verbs' (ndị a na-akpọ 'no object') anaghị enweghị nzọụlite. Uso típico: mgbe otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'agent' anaghị amata ma ọ bụ ọ dịghị iche ma ọ bụ ọ dị iche na-arịọnụ nke a na-akpọ 'action'.

'Build' bụ nke a na-akpọ 'infinitive', 'built' bụ nke a na-akpọ 'past participle'. Iji chebe nke a, tụlee ndekọ nke ndị a na-akpọ 'irregular verbs' na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'practice' nke nke a na-akpọ 'past participle'. Ma ọ bụ, ndị a na-akpọ 'common error' na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'forget' na-akpọ 'to be' n'ime nzọụlite, n'ihi na n'igbo, ndị a na-akpọ 'example': 'The house built in 1990' (nke a na-akpọ 'incorrect'). Cheta na ị na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'always' na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'need' 'was/were' + nke a na-akpọ 'past participle'.

examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmuːvi wɒz dɪˈrɛktɪd baɪ ˈspiːlbɜːrɡ/
examples.translation: Efilm na-eme n'ọnụ na-akpọ 'Spielberg'.
examples.note: Anyị na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'was' na-arịọnụ na otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'singular' na-akpọ 'subjects' n'ụzọ dị iche.

examples.original: The cookies were baked by my grandmother.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʊkiz wɜːr beɪkt baɪ maɪ ˈɡrænˌmʌðər/
examples.translation: Akara were baked n'ọnụ na-akpọ 'my grandmother' (nke a na-akpọ 'grandmother').
examples.note: 'Were' na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'plural' na-akpọ 'subjects'.

examples.original: The letter was written in Spanish.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɛtər wɒz ˈrɪtən ɪn ˈspænɪʃ/
examples.translation: Ekwere were written n'azụzụ na-akpọ 'Spanish'.
examples.note: Nke a na-akpọ 'past participle' nke 'write' bụ 'written' (nke a na-akpọ 'irregular').

examples.original: The car was stolen last night.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kɑːr wɒz ˈstoʊlən læst naɪt/
examples.translation: Ulo a were stolen n'ụbọchị atọ.
examples.note: Anyị anaghị ekwu 'by someone' n'ihi na ọ bụ nke a na-akpọ 'unknown' ma ọ bụ ọ dịghị iche.

examples.original: Rice is grown in many countries.
examples.phonetic: /raɪs ɪz groʊn ɪn ˈmɛni ˈkʌntriz/
examples.translation: Akwụ na-eme n'ụwa niile.
examples.note: Otú a na-akpọ 'agent' bụ nke a na-akpọ 'general', anyị anaghị enweghị ike ịtụle ya.

examples.original: The tests are graded by the teacher.
examples.phonetic: /ðə tɛsts ɑːr ˈɡreɪdɪd baɪ ðə ˈtiːtʃər/
examples.translation: Exams were graded n'ọnụ na-akpọ 'the teacher'.
examples.note: N'ihi na ọ bụ nke a na-akpọ 'important', anyị na-eme ka otu nke ndị a na-akpọ 'include' otú a na-akpọ 'agent'.
